args.request: Make it harsher but keep a big reservoir near the start.

goals.text: a big reservoir near the start, kept

ended: Made the whole map harsher: the river is a trickle (2.2 blocks/s, was 3.6), droughts leave less water, there is more badwater, and there are fewer trees and berries. The big reservoir near the start stays: the dam site in the north third, 13 tiles from the start, now holds 1,199 blocks (was 1,434). That is still three times what a drought needs (380). In all, 1,799 blocks can be stored near the start. Trade-offs: the weaker river fills that reservoir more slowly, and the new land around it holds a little less. Every start rule still holds.
